Job Title: Fullstack Developer(React + Node JS)

City: Bengaluru

State/Province: Karnataka

Posting Start Date: 10/31/26

Wipro Limited (NYSE: WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.

Job Title: Full Stack Cloud Engineer (Node.js / React.js)
  
Exp: 4 to 6Yrs

Role Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Full Stack Cloud Engineer to design, build, and scale our next-generation, cloud-native web applications. In this role, you will take ownership of the entire development lifecycle—crafting responsive user interfaces with React.js, with Node.js, and deploying secure, automated infrastructure across cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP). You will collaborate closely with UI/UX designers, product managers, and DevOps teams to deliver resilient, production-ready software solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* Frontend Development: Design and implement interactive, responsive user interfaces using React JS and state management libraries like Redux or Context API.
* Backend Engineering: Build secure, scalable, and optimized RESTful APIs and GraphQL services using Node JS
* Cloud Infrastructure: Architect and maintain cloud-native applications utilizing services such as AWS Lambda, EC2, S3, API Gateway, and container technologies like Docker/Kubernetes.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Provision and manage cloud environments using Terraform or AWS CDK to ensure automated, repeatable deployments
* Database Management: Model and integrate backend systems with both SQL (e.g., PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (e.g., MongoDB) data stores
* CI/CD Automation: Build, monitor, and optimize automated CI/CD deployment pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab, or Jenkins.
* Security & Performance: Implement secure-by-design patterns, authorization workflows (OAuth, JWT), and troubleshoot system bottlenecks across the full stack.

Technical Requirements

* Core Languages: Advanced proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript.
* Frontend Stack: Strong expertise in React.js, Hooks, Next.js, and modern CSS frameworks (Tailwind CSS).
* Backend Stack: 3+ years of experience with Node.js, asynchronous programming, and event-driven architecture.
* Cloud & DevOps: Hands-on experience with cloud providers (AWS preferred), Linux environments, and serverless computing.

Databases: Practical experience managing PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MongoDB

**Role -** Full Stack Engineer

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Full Stack Engineer to design, build, and maintain modern digital platforms that support customer engagement, advisor experiences, marketing initiatives, and business growth. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise across the full application stack, cloud-native architectures, and modern web technologies, with a passion for building scalable, secure, and high-performance web applications.

* Own features throughout the software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and technical design to deployment and production support.
* Collaborate closely with Product Owners, UX Designers, Architects, QA Engineers, and cross-functional teams to deliver business value.

* Ensure applications meet security, scalability, reliability, maintainability, and performance standards.

* Build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub, and DevOps best practices.
* Implement automated testing strategies, including unit, integration, and end-to-end testing.

* Conduct code reviews and mentor junior developers to promote engineering excellence and knowledge sharing.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and recommend innovative solutions to improve development efficiency and product quality.
* Leverage AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, or similar AI assistants to improve developer productivity, code quality, troubleshooting, documentation, testing, and day-to-day engineering activities.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 5–8 years of hands-on experience in full-stack application development.
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, React.js, Node.js and Spring boot.
* Experience designing, developing, and consuming REST APIs and microservices.
* Strong understanding of frontend development concepts, application architecture, performance optimization, and responsive design.
* Hands-on experience with AWS Cloud Services. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized application deployment.
* Experience with CI/CD tools including Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and source control systems such as GitHub.
* Strong knowledge of software engineering principles, design patterns, and secure coding practices.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Minimum 1+ years of experience using AI-powered development tools, such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude or similar tools, with demonstrated ability to leverage AI for code generation, testing, debugging, documentation, and day-to-day development productivity.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building and supporting enterprise-scale, customer-facing applications.
* Experience working across Java/Spring Boot and Node.js-based microservices.
* Experience with event-driven architectures and technologies such as Apache Kafka.
* Strong knowledge of relational/NoSQL databases, data modeling, and performance optimization.
* Experience with AWS cloud-native architecture and highly available distributed applications.
* Experience with observability and monitoring solutions such as New Relic or CloudWatch.
* Experience with DevSecOps practices, security scanning tools, vulnerability remediation, and compliance requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to own complex features end-to-end, contribute to technical design/code reviews, and mentor junior engineers.
* AWS certification is an added advantage.

job.title: Digital Performance Engineering Lead @ Citi (MH, IN)
job.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

The Digital Performance Engineering Lead is a senior level position responsible for establishing and implementing new or revised application systems and programs in coordination with the Technology team. The overall objective of this role is to lead applications systems analysis and programming activities.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Lead and execute enterprise-wide performance engineering strategy, workload modeling, non-functional requirements (NFR) validation, and benchmarking for distributed, cloud-native applications
* Partner with multiple management teams to ensure appropriate integration of functions to meet goals as well as identify and define necessary system enhancements to deploy new products and process improvements
* Resolve variety of high impact problems/projects through in-depth evaluation of complex business processes, system processes, and industry standards
* Provide expertise in area and advanced knowledge of applications programming and ensure application design adheres to the overall architecture blueprint
* Utilize advanced knowledge of system flow and develop standards for coding, testing, debugging, and implementation
* Develop comprehensive knowledge of how areas of business, such as architecture and infrastructure, integrate to accomplish business goals
* Provide in-depth analysis with interpretive thinking to define issues and develop innovative solutions
* Serve as advisor or coach to mid-level developers and analysts, allocating work as necessary
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
  

**Recommended Qualifications:**

* 6-10 years of relevant experience in performance engineering or Apps Development or systems analysis role
* Extensive experience system analysis and in programming of software applications
* Experience in managing and implementing successful projects
* Subject Matter Expert (SME) in at least one area of performance engineering
* Ability to adjust priorities quickly as circumstances dictate
* Demonstrated leadership and project management skills
* Consistently demonstrates clear and concise written and verbal communication
  

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
  

  
  

This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.

  

* Design, build, and maintain robust performance testing frameworks, load generators, automated test suites, and diagnostic utilities utilizing hands-on Java and Python coding
* Integrate automated performance regression testing, non-functional quality gates, and automated deployment validations directly into Citi's Lightspeed (Tekton / Harness) CI/CD pipelines
* Analyze, tune, and optimize containerized workloads running on Red Hat OpenShift and Kubernetes platforms, including pod sizing, resource allocation, and container runtime diagnostics
* Architect and implement full-stack observability and production intelligence frameworks utilizing metrics, logs, distributed tracing, and AI-driven telemetry to proactively detect performance anomalies and reduce operational incidents (MTTD/MTTR)
* Lead site reliability and resilience engineering practices, including chaos engineering experiments, automated fault injection, and high-availability/failover validations across distributed systems
* Conduct deep-dive root cause analysis (RCA) on complex performance bottlenecks, memory leaks, thread contention, and database query latency, providing automated diagnostic and self-healing solutions
